Every place a word occurs, with the original-language word and its English side by side.

Give an English word, a Strong’s number, or both. With both, each place is marked: both (the unit contains the English word), only the original (translated another way), or only the English (it translates a different original), with a count for each and chips to filter.
End with a scope to limit it: a book, a group of books, OT or NT (see scopes).
One Strong’s number and one English word at most; the English word matches whole words only (use forms, or search zeal*, for endings). When the word is not in the scope but other forms of it are, the pane names them with a button for each.
The pane shows full verses with the matching words marked, a book filter with counts, and tick boxes to add places to a thread (see results).

  uses zeal    every “zeal”
  uses H7065 zealous    where qânâʼ and “zealous” meet and where they part
  uses H7065 pentateuch    qânâʼ in the first five books
  uses love gospels    “love” in Matthew–John
